page.layout: One printed page, single column of text, with an ornamental headpiece above the title and a woodcut initial Q at the start of the body; faint show-through of the reverse page is visible on the right and must be ignored; page number "2" with a printer's mark at the foot right.

main_text.head: MAGNIFICIS, AMPLIS- SIMIS, PIETATE, VIRTVTE, ET prudentia, praestantissimis viris, D. D. PROCONSVLI, CONSVLIBVS, ET SENATORIBVS, FLORENTISSIMAE AC CELEBERRIMAE REIPVBLICAE DANTISCANAE, Sapientissimis, Dominis summa obseruantia colendis:

p.i: IACOBVS AD PORTVM, H. BERNAS, Gratiam, & pacem, à Deo, per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum, precatur.

main_text.p: VAM necessaria sit VIRI amplissimi, ac prudentissimi, ad beatam illam immortalitatem, vitam, ac salutem æternam consequendam, Iesu Christi, Domini, Redemptoris, ac Saluatoris nostri, & beneficiorum spiritualium, nobis per ipsum partorum, notitia & cognitio, non quidem otiosa & sterilis, quæ frigida speculatione, & nuda atque eua-

page.notes: The opening Q of "QVAM" is a large woodcut initial and is transcribed as "VAM" joined to the initial; the initial letter is shown as Q in the image. Line "Sapientissimis , Dominis" and "co- lendis" are as printed. Show-through from the reverse page (right margin and lower area) was disregarded. The printer's mark "*" beside the page number was not transcribed.
